plain: John Herrington, a former US Secretary of Energy, the cabinet member in charge of the Energy Department, says he went back several times to testify to Congress in closed, restricted sessions. He says these were about security issues at the Energy Department, especially at Rocky Flats, a government site in Colorado. He tells it on Jesse Michels's podcast as part of what he knows of secret government matters.
